candidates.change_summary: Replace `_locked = false;` with `_locked = true;` so reentrancy lock never releases and subsequent airdrops always revert, but first airdrop still succeeds and balance differs for caller.
Replace `tokenBalance[msg.sender] += 20;` with `tokenBalance[msg.sender] += 0;` so airdrop succeeds silently without increasing balance.
Delete `tokenBalance[msg.sender] += 20;` so balance never increases after passing checks.
Replace `require(tokenBalance[msg.sender] == 0);` with `require(tokenBalance[msg.sender] == 1);` so only addresses with balance of 1 can receive airdrop, altering final balances.

Move `tokenBalance[msg.sender] += 20;` before `require(((tokenBalance[msg.sender] + 20) >= tokenBalance[msg.sender]));` causing overflow check on already modified balance, potentially allowing overflow or different revert behavior.

Replace `require(keccak256(abi.encodePacked("Nu Token")) == Bank(msg.sender).supportsToken());` with `require(keccak256(abi.encodePacked("Wrong Token")) == Bank(msg.sender).supportsToken());` so only callers returning wrong token hash pass, changing which callers succeed.
Delete `_locked = false;` so lock never resets and airdrop can only be called once, preventing future balance changes for other keys.
Replace `tokenBalance[msg.sender] += 20;` with `tokenBalance[address(0)] += 20;` so balance is credited to zero address instead of caller.
Replaced the airDrop balance increment with a decrement of 20 via unchecked subtraction.
Changed the airDrop balance update to add 10 instead of 20.
Weakened the reentrancy guard to require the locked flag to be true before entering.
Set the locked flag to false instead of true before executing the guarded body.
Deleted the line that unlocks the guard after the guarded body executes.
Changed hasNoBalance to require a nonzero caller balance instead of zero.
Changed supportsToken to compare against the hash of 'Other Token'.
Replace the reentrancy lock check require(!_locked) with require(true), disabling the nonReentrant guard's precondition.
Delete the assignment _locked = true so the lock is never set during execution of the guarded body.
Delete the assignment _locked = false so the lock remains set after the guarded body returns.
Drop the supportsToken modifier invocation from airDrop so anyone can call it regardless of token support.
Drop the hasNoBalance modifier invocation from airDrop so accounts with an existing balance can also receive the airdrop.
Drop the _nonReentrant modifier invocation from airDrop so reentrant calls during the airdrop are no longer blocked.
Replace the require overflow check condition with require(true), making the guard always pass.
Replace the balance increment of 20 with an increment of 21 for the caller's tokenBalance.
Replace the expected name hash with hashed "Other Token" so only unsupported tokens match.
Replace the zero-balance precondition check with require(true), allowing callers with existing balances through.
Removed the supportsToken modifier invocation from airDrop, allowing any caller to receive tokens.

candidates.change_summary: Removed the zero-balance precondition from hasNoBalance, allowing any caller to receive tokens.
Weakened the reentrancy guard in _nonReentrant by replacing require(!_locked) with require(true), disabling the lock check.
Removed the _locked = true assignment in _nonReentrant, so the modifier never marks the contract as locked.
Weakened the supportsToken check by replacing the keccak256 comparison with a call that only checks the call succeeds via extcodesize.
Replaced the airDrop balance-invariant require with a check against the max uint value, making large balances revert.
Moved the token balance update before the supportsToken external call via modifier reordering.
Deleted the require(!_locked) check in _nonReentrant.
Replaced _locked = true with _locked = false in _nonReentrant.
Deleted the _locked = false reset in _nonReentrant.
Changed the hasNoBalance guard to require tokenBalance[msg.sender] != 0.
Inverted the supportsToken check to require inequality with the token hash.
Remove the hasNoBalance modifier from airDrop so an address with an existing balance no longer reverts under that guard.
Remove the supportsToken modifier from airDrop so callers whose msg.sender does not implement the token check no longer revert under that guard.
Remove the _nonReentrant modifier from airDrop so reentrant calls are no longer blocked by the lock guard.
Weaken the reentrancy guard so a call while _locked is true is allowed instead of reverting.
Change the lock flag assignment so _locked is never set to true, disabling the reentrancy protection during the guarded call.
Change the final lock reset so _locked is set to true instead of false after the guarded call returns.
Change the supportsToken modifier's hash comparison to use a different literal string, so the token-support check no longer matches Nu Token.
Change the hasNoBalance guard so it reverts when the caller's balance is nonzero instead of when it is zero.
Remove the reentrancy guard check require(!_locked) from _nonReentrant, allowing reentrant calls when locked.
Change the reentrancy guard require(!_locked) to require(_locked), which inverts lock semantics and reverts on unlocked calls.
Change _locked = true to _locked = false in _nonReentrant, so the guard never actually locks during execution.
Delete the supportsToken modifier invocation from airDrop, removing the external tokentype check on callers.
Delete the hasNoBalance modifier invocation from airDrop, removing the requirement that the caller has zero balance.
Delete the _nonReentrant modifier invocation from airDrop, removing the reentrancy guard on the function.
Change tokenBalance[msg.sender] += 20 to tokenBalance[msg.sender] = 20, so the added amount is overwritten rather than accumulated.
Change the supportsToken check to always require true, making the modifier accept any caller.
Change hasNoBalance requirement from == 0 to >= 0, allowing callers with nonzero balances to pass the modifier.
